facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland buyers are gaining the upper hand right now as lending conditions improve — and what sellers need to know about it
facebook.post_text:
More buyers are back in East Auckland — and they are ready to move. 🏡

A lot of homeowners are watching the market from the sidelines, unsure if now is the right moment. Meanwhile, improving lending conditions are bringing confident, pre-approved buyers back into open homes right now.

👉 Buyer enquiries in East Auckland have picked up noticeably this autumn
👉 Pre-approved buyers are making faster decisions when the right home appears
👉 Homes that are well-presented and well-priced are not sitting long

The window where buyers outnumber good listings is exactly when sellers win. ✨

✔️ More competition between buyers means stronger offers
✔️ Motivated buyers in autumn are serious — not just browsing
✔️ Getting your home in front of this audience now could make a real difference to your result

The market does not wait — and neither do the right buyers. If you have been thinking about selling, this shift matters for you.
